public_sources.bound_semantics: TCP accepts sequence-space data only within the advertised receive window; a zero window admits no ordinary data, providing bounded flow control/backpressure.
TCP SACK represents non-contiguous received blocks beyond the cumulative acknowledgment; the cumulative ACK advances when missing data fills the left-edge gap.
SCTP SACK carries a Cumulative TSN Ack plus Gap Ack Blocks and advertised receiver-window credit, combining contiguous-prefix progress with bounded receiving capacity.

chat_native_reduction.window_mapping: The capacity-3 role-local window counts every epoch that is not yet reclaimable, including a terminal-readback-closed epoch behind an older gap, analogous to received/outstanding sequence-space that still occupies protocol state.
chat_native_reduction.cumulative_mapping: finalized-through is a cumulative acknowledgment; closed later epochs remain exact gap state until the oldest gap closes.
chat_native_reduction.backpressure_rule: When three epochs occupy tracked state, the controller does not open another epoch; this is a local scheduling guard, not a throughput claim.

credit_rule: At most one role-local credit after exact terminal readback; this file creation alone earns zero credit.
scope_limit: Fixed capacity-3 role-local trace only. This does not prove liveness if the oldest gap never reaches terminal/aborted readback; that remains the next child problem.
